grammar.title: Going to vs will
grammar.explanation: Pakai 'be going to' untuk rencana yang sudah diputuskan sebelumnya. Pakai 'will' untuk keputusan spontan saat bicara, janji, atau tawaran. Jangan lupa 'am/is/are' sebelum 'going to'.
examples: We're going to release it on Monday.
The build failed? I'll check it right now.
I'll send you the link after the meeting.

common_mistake.wrong: I going to fix it tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I'm going to fix it tomorrow.

grammar.title: Feedback dan information tidak bisa dijamak
grammar.explanation: Beberapa kata benda dalam bahasa Inggris tidak bisa dihitung, jadi tidak diberi -s dan tidak memakai 'a': feedback, information, advice, equipment, software. Untuk jumlah, pakai 'some', 'a lot of', atau 'a piece of'.
examples: I need some information about the API.
She gave me a useful piece of advice.

reading.title: What makes a good bug report
reading.text: A good bug report saves hours of work. First, give it a clear title, such as 'Checkout button does nothing on iPhone'. Next, explain the steps to reproduce the problem, one by one. Then describe what you expected to happen and what actually happened. Screenshots or a short video help a lot, especially for design issues. Finally, add details like the device, the browser, and the app version. Developers often say that a bug they can reproduce is a bug they can fix. When reports are vague, like 'the app is broken', the team has to figure out everything from the beginning, and the fix takes much longer.

questions.q: What kind of title should a bug report have?
Why are steps to reproduce important?
options: Developers can see the bug for themselves
They make the report look professional

questions.q: What happens when a report is vague?

writing.prompt: Kamu menemukan bug: tombol 'Pay' di halaman checkout tidak berfungsi di HP. Tulis pesan Slack singkat ke tim developer. Jelaskan masalahnya, langkah memunculkannya, dan apa yang seharusnya terjadi.
checklist: Ringkasan masalah ada di kalimat pertama
Ada perbandingan yang diharapkan vs yang terjadi (I expected ..., but ...)
useful_phrases: Let me know if you need more details.
writing.model_answer:
Hi team,

I've found a bug on the checkout page: the Pay button does nothing on mobile.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the app on an Android phone (Chrome).
2. Add any item to the cart.
3. Tap Pay.

I expected the payment form to open, but nothing happens. It works fine on desktop. I've attached a short video.

Let me know if you need more information. Happy to test the fix.

Thanks,
Bagus

speaking.focus: Bunyi 'th' pada 'thanks' dan 'the', serta tekanan kata: pri-OR-i-ty, re-LEASE, FEED-back.

speaking.prompt: Ceritakan dalam 3 sampai 4 kalimat: aplikasi atau situs apa yang menurutmu paling user-friendly, dan kenapa?
speaking.sample_answer: I think my banking app is very user-friendly. The design is clean, so I can find what I need in a few seconds. It also works well on both my phone and my laptop. The only thing I'd improve is the loading speed.

n1.them: Hi! Thanks for joining. Have you had a chance to look at the new onboarding design?
hints: sudah: Yes, I've taken a look at it

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Yes, I took a look at it this morning."

n2b.them: No problem. In short, we've cut the sign-up steps from five to three. What do you think?
hints: beri pendapat: I think ... / That sounds ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "That sounds great. Fewer steps should make it more user-friendly."

n2.them: Great. So what do you think of it overall?
hints: pendapat umum: It looks ..., I like ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Overall it looks clean and user-friendly. I like the new progress bar."

n3.them: Thanks! Is there anything that might be hard to build?
hints: tidak ada: It should be fine

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "The animation on the last screen might take some time to build."

n4a.them: Good point. Could we keep it simple for the first release and improve it later?
hints: setuju dan usulkan langkah: Sure, let's ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Sure, let's release a simple version first and roll out the animation later."

n4b.them: Perfect. When do you think it could go live?
hints: beri perkiraan: by next Friday / in two weeks

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "If nothing changes, it could go live by next Friday."

end.them: Great, I'll send you the final files today. Thanks for the feedback!
